name: agentarmy-otel-collector
description: OpenTelemetry Collector function-tier image — sidecar to every spoke + standalone fleet collector. Receives OTLP (gRPC :4317, HTTP :4318) from spokes, batches, redacts PII, and exports to one or more backends (Grafana Tempo, Honeycomb, Tempo+Loki, or a local file). Realizes ARC-ADR-010 (observability standard) and the OTel-init remediation track from ARC-ADR-024 (platform maturity audit). Scaffolded as part of the contract-backlog PR; Dockerfile + collector-config.yaml land in the follow-up implementation issue.

shims.note: Base image already contains the collector + contrib processors/exporters. No additional package installs needed; configuration is mounted at runtime via OTELCOL_CONFIG_PATH env or baked at /etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml.

baked.purpose: PLANNED — sidecar collector config: OTLP receivers + batch processor + per-backend exporter blocks (env-gated).
PLANNED — fleet collector config: same shape, plus tail-sampler for cost control.

doctor.description: PLANNED — /:13133 health 200; gRPC OTLP send on :4317 returns OK; HTTP OTLP send on :4318 returns 200; configured backend exporter receives the span (verified per-backend).

deploy.notes: Two deployment modes: (a) sidecar — co-deployed with each spoke, no public ingress; (b) standalone fleet collector — public ingress for cross-cloud span aggregation.

contract.note: OTel trace-context contract (XC-2 in backlog). The collector itself is config-driven; the contract is the W3C trace-context propagation + OTLP wire format it consumes.
